raw.query: SELECT experiment, run_id, pool, sla_metric, p50_ms, p99_ms, n_requests FROM v_pool_latency WHERE experiment = 'g3_32b' AND is_current AND (run_id ILIKE '%235b%' OR run_id ILIKE '%32b%') ORDER BY sla_metric, run_id LIMIT 20
raw.observed: v_pool_latency for g3_32b contains only language-pool itl/ttft metrics; no encoder_delay, no SLA metric for any projector or encoder component, and no column stores projector/hidden dimension. A full-text search for 'projector','4096','5120','handoff','GEMM' across all provenance text columns returned zero architecture-parameter hits.
raw.claimed: the 235B shares the 4096-dimensional projector target unchanged; the 32B's 5120-dimensional projector scales only its final GEMM and handoff bytes
raw.evidence: Claim is about the aiconfigurator cost model's internal architecture (projector dimension, final GEMM, handoff bytes). The provenance DB records latency/cost aggregates from simulation runs, not model-architecture parameters or per-layer cost decompositions at the projector level. The g3_32b experiment has four models (235B-A22B/30B-A3B/32B/8B) but only language-pool data with no encoder/projector breakdown. The expected backing view v_pool_latency cannot verify any part of the claim.
raw.fix: Either store the aiconfigurator cost model's projector-dimension/hidden-dimension parameters as collector_scalar or collector_system_spec rows keyed by model_checkpoint, or add an encoder-delay column to v_pool_latency for multi-model encoder experiments that allow verifying that the 32B-to-235B encoder-cost ratio matches the 5120/4096 = 1.25 dimension scaling on only the final GEMM + handoff terms.
